faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at IIITDM Kancheepuram?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant post is 01 September 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech. / B.E. in Electronics Engineering or related branches, or an M.E. / M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Optoelectronics, or Laser Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position at IIITDM Kancheepuram.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The job type is contractual, as indicated in the recruitment details.
